name: Popover
description: Non-modal panel anchored to a trigger, for extra controls or details. Open it with DialogTrigger.

label.description: Accessible name for the popover content.

placement.description: Preferred side of the trigger. Flips when there isn't room.

showArrow.description: Shows an arrow pointing at the trigger.

children.description: Popover content. A function receives close().

keyboard: Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger
requirements: Focus moves into the popover on open
screenReader: Opening announces a dialog named by its label (Filters)
Its controls are reachable with Tab; Esc announces the trigger again

use_when: Filters, quick settings or details related to a control
